checks: Fresh-kitchen feedback explains the cooking-water prerequisite without creating a saved supply.
Actual phone dip, lift and level carry show a filled bowl while water, evidence and cooking time remain unchanged.
Levelling the tipped ladle or cancelling a real touch returns the preview to the pot without saving water.
Tip and release conserve exactly 50 mL, record one canonical action, and restore the jug, allowance and receipt on reload.
The new panel routes to focused keyboard ladle and careful draining tools without changing evidence on navigation.
An external cooking-state change cancels a loaded native ladle even when pot-water volume stays the same.
Using saved water never refills the recipe allowance, and drained water is unavailable for collection.
The saved-water panel fits a 320px screen and passes accessibility checks with forced colors and reduced motion.
